questions.q: To embed a new query with the fitted TF-IDF plus SVD pipeline, which should you call?
options: fit_transform on the query alone, so the model adapts to it
transform through the same fitted vectorizer and SVD used for the documents
Nothing; queries do not need to be embedded
A different, freshly fitted model, to avoid bias
questions.explain: Queries must live in the same vector space as the documents, so pass them through the already-fitted objects with transform.

questions.q: What are the four steps every embedding application follows in this lesson?
options: Create embeddings, embed the query with the same model, compare, rank
Tokenize, backpropagate, evaluate, deploy
Cluster, label, split, retrain
Sample, shuffle, average, report
questions.explain: Create, embed the query with the same model, compare to stored vectors, and rank by score.

questions.q: For the query "my parcel is late", which tickets scored highest?
options: Billing tickets about card charges
Login and password tickets
A random mix of all topics
Shipping tickets such as "shipment delivery delayed again" (0.94)
questions.explain: The top three (7, 9 and 5) were all shipping tickets, at 0.94, 0.91 and 0.91.

questions.q: On unit-length vectors, how do the dot product and cosine similarity relate?
options: They are equal
The dot product is always exactly double the cosine
They always have opposite signs
They are unrelated
questions.explain: Cosine is the dot product divided by the two vector lengths, and unit vectors have length 1. The demo printed 0.999 for both.
